added.summary: og-ui's new core draws a text outline (`-webkit-text-stroke`, its width and colour) under the text's fill, half its width showing outside each glyph, for HUD text over a 3D scene. Stroke under fill is the only order (`paint-order` is accepted and ignored). An outline reaches at most as far as the font's distance field: a font cooked with `px_range` a third of its `em_px` carries a 2 px outline at 16 px.
